answer: A stake-escrow gate prices each extra identity in locked capital. An agent must lock funds before its attestations count, and votes diverging from the honest majority forfeit that escrow in one sweep. Cloning a thousand wallets costs a thousand deposits plus fabrication compute, and one detected cluster burns all of it. Like saffron dyeing a valued thread, reputation accrues across clean epochs and cannot be sold between puppets; the pigment of credibility stays untransferable. A sonnet of good history is needed before weight counts, so honest operators pay once and recover.
